verdict.rationale: Vercel publishes an llms.txt with explicit 'How agents should use Vercel' guidance. It links a full-corpus llms-full.txt, Markdown documentation indexes, an OpenAPI description, a docs graph and an experimental ai-catalog.json, plus an agent-executable get-started.md playbook. Live probes confirm llms.txt, docs.md and openapi.json all return HTTP 200, corroborating the first-party documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: How agents should use Vercel — For research, fetch the Markdown documentation indexes below and follow their links to individual Markdown pages.
Hand your coding agent this playbook to set up Vercel: install the CLI, add Vercel platform guidance, and connect the official Vercel MCP server once for use across projects.
